input.summary: Carve terminations out of the § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment so the § 9.4 convenience right is effective and penalty-free
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 9.4 gives us a 30-day convenience termination with a pro-rata refund, but § 2.1 makes the three-year USD 2,000,000 minimum "without reduction or termination rights," which would leave us owing the full shortfall and turn that right into a penalty. We have carved terminations out of the commitment so it reduces pro rata on termination; if Copperleaf needs some recovery, we can discuss a cap not exceeding three months' Fees.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis; provided that this commitment is reduced pro rata for, and Customer owes no shortfall, early-termination, or similar amount on account of, any termination or partial termination of this Agreement or an Order Form under § 9.4 or any other provision of this Agreement.
